episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.summary: With the country in crisis and her husband held hostage, the newly-elected British prime minister turns to the visiting French president for help.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.summary: Dalton looks for ways to rescue her husband without informing the cabinet. But without Toussaint's help, there's no chance of saving him.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.summary: As the UK terror threat level rises to critical, the kidnappers go quiet. The two heads of state discuss a deal that could save them both.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.summary: A grieving Dalton faces her mutinous cabinet and Toussaint confronts her furious husband. Despite everything, the leaders finally reach an agreement.

episodes.title: Episode 5
episodes.summary: A state of emergency is declared across the country. With the military in control, Dalton must find who's behind it all before it's too late.
